sentences.text:
Author: T. Vinod Kumar
Bench: T. Vinod Kumar
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice T. Vinod Kumar
 Civil Revision Petition No.215 of 2023
Order:
1. This Civil Revision Petition is filed to direct the XV Additional District Judge-cum-II Additional Family Judge, Ranga Reddy District at Kukatpally to expedite the hearing in O.P. No.594 of 2019.

entities.text: XV Additional District Judge-cum-II Additional Family Judge, Ranga Reddy District at Kukatpally
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Heard learned Counsel for the petitioner and perused the record.
3.
Petitioner herein had filed the O.P. seeking for grant of divorce from the respondent on the ground of cruelty and desertion.

Petitioner further contends that vexed with the attitude of the respondent- wife, he is seeking for grant of divorce as the respondent had involved the petitioner in multiple cases under DVC Act, thereupon under Section 498A IPC being CC No.114 of 2016 which has resulted in acquittal on 06.04.2021.

4. It is to be seen that admittedly the O.P. is of the year 2019 and similar such matters filed even prior thereto are pending before the court below for consideration.
5.
In view of the same, this Court is of the view no direction as sought for in the present Revision can be given.
6. Accordingly, this Civil Revision Petition is without merit and is, accordingly, dismissed.
Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Writ Petition shall stand closed.
MRKR THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE T. VINOD KUMAR CIVIL REVISION PETITION No.215 of 2023 21.04.2023
